> 第十二章 进入秘境（第1页）
李磊迷迷糊糊的好像做了一个梦，但那梦竟如此的真实，准确来说那是一个秘境!
这秘境是一个暗紫色的空间，四周除了一团团紫色雾气之外什么都没有。
李磊发现秘境这般如此后略感失望无奈的摇了摇头。
忽然弥漫在秘境四周的紫色雾气竟聚集在了一起，融合成了一个巨型紫色气团。
看到这般情形李磊便开始仔细观察那个巨型紫色气团，他是想看看这个气团里面有没有宝贝，可李磊无论怎么观察，这个气团依旧是那般神秘。
“没有宝贝吗，不应该啊”李磊喃喃自语道。
“哈哈哈，年轻人，我可不是什么宝贝”
忽然那个声音又出现了，之前那个声音李磊没有理会，那是因为李磊认为这个空间真的只有自己一个人，如果听到另外一个声音就是幻听，那现在可就不同了，幻听可不会这么真实。
忽然那巨型紫色气团竟消失不见了，取而代之的是一个紫色虚影。
这个虚影和刚才那巨大的气团比起来非常的渺小，但李磊可以看出这虚影的的确确是那巨型紫色气团所形成的。
虽然这虚影很是神秘但同时他身上却又散发出了一种舍我其谁的王者姿态，这与生俱来的王者气势，可不是靠装就能装出来的。
“你是谁？这里是什么地方？你把我弄到这里要干什么”
面对李磊的灵魂拷问那虚影又是一笑，随后不紧不慢的回答道:“我是谁，不重要，这里是什么地方，你也不需要知道，你只需要知道的是，你可能是我魔道最后一丝烛火了”
很显然这虚影给李磊带来的信息量实在是太大了，听的李磊都没有反应过来。
“顺者凡，逆为仙，逆则再逆皆为魔。自古仙魔两立，可谁知仙就是魔，魔便是仙!正义并非是仙，邪恶并非是魔。左右他们的乃是心!!!”
可那虚影却没有回答李磊的问题，依旧自顾自的说道。
李磊听了那虚影的话开始反复思考了起来。
“记住我说的话年轻人，魔道就靠你了”
还没等李磊反应过来，李磊的身体竟被那虚影推离了那个秘境。
此时铸魔洞窟内，那充斥着满洞的紫色气体已经完全进入李磊体内，当所有的气体进入李磊的身体之后，李磊也是醒了过来。
“嘶～～好痛!”李磊扶着脑袋从地上爬了起来。
“这气体虽然是魔气，但实际上是对你修炼有帮助的宝物，如果能成功将它炼化成为地仙中期不成问题”石头见李磊一醒来就满脸心事，以为害怕这魔气的危害便向他解释道。
“没什么，我昏迷的时候其实进入了一个幻境”
“不知道，碰见一个虚影，应该是一个魔道中人，他想拉我入伙”李磊尴尬的答道。
“到底是谁呢”石头开始思考起来。
“管他呢，没准不是幻境也许只是一个梦而已，赶紧告诉我三样东西在哪”
李磊调整好心态便准备取石头所说的那三样东西。
要不是石头死缠烂打劝说李磊来，李磊可不想在这多带，毕竟李磊还要继续赶路呢，可不能耽误时辰。

> Chapter 12 Entering the Secret Realm (Page 1)
Li Lei felt as if he had a dream, but the dream was so real. To be precise, it was a secret realm!
This secret realm is a dark purple space, surrounded by nothing but clouds of purple mist.
Li Lei was slightly disappointed when he discovered that the secret realm was like this and shook his head helplessly.
Suddenly, the purple mist that filled the surroundings of the secret realm gathered together and merged into a giant purple air mass.
Seeing this situation, Li Lei began to carefully observe the giant purple air mass. He wanted to see if there was any treasure in the air mass, but no matter how Li Lei looked, the air mass was still so mysterious.
"Don't you have a baby? It shouldn't be," Li Lei murmured to himself.
"Hahaha, young man, I am not a treasure."
Suddenly the voice appeared again. Li Lei ignored the previous voice. That was because Li Lei believed that he was the only one in this space. If hearing another voice was an auditory hallucination, it was different now. Auditory hallucinations would not be so real.
Suddenly, the giant purple air mass disappeared and was replaced by a purple shadow.
This phantom was very small compared to the huge air ball just now, but Li Lei could see that the phantom was indeed formed by the giant purple air ball.
Although this shadow is very mysterious, at the same time, he exudes a kingly attitude. This innate kingly aura cannot be faked by pretending.
"Who are you? What is this place? Why did you bring me here?"
Facing Li Lei's soul torture, the phantom smiled again, and then replied unhurriedly: "It doesn't matter who I am, and you don't need to know where this is. All you need to know is that you may be the last candle of my demonic path."
Obviously, the amount of information this phantom brought to Li Lei was so great that Li Lei didn't even react.
"Those who obey will become immortals, those who go against will become immortals, and those who go against will become demons. Since ancient times, immortals and demons have existed, but who knew that immortals are demons and demons are immortals! Justice is not immortal, and evil is not demon. What controls them is the heart!!!"
But the phantom did not answer Li Lei's question and continued to talk to himself.
After hearing what the phantom said, Li Lei began to think over and over again.
"Remember what I said young man, the magic path depends on you."
Before Li Lei could react, Li Lei's body was pushed away from the secret realm by the phantom.
At this time, the purple gas that filled the cave had completely entered Li Lei's body. When all the gas entered Li Lei's body, Li Lei also woke up.
"Hiss~ It hurts!" Li Lei climbed up from the ground holding his head.
"Although this gas is demonic, it is actually a treasure that is helpful to your cultivation. If you can successfully refine it into a mid-stage Earth Immortal, there will be no problem." Shitou saw that Li Lei's face was full of worry as soon as he woke up, so he explained to him because he was afraid of the harm of this demonic gas.
"It's nothing. I actually entered a fantasy world when I was unconscious."
"I don't know. I met a phantom. It must be a man from the devil's path. He wants to get me to join his gang," Li Lei replied awkwardly.
"Who is it?" Shitou began to think.
"Whatever, it might not be an illusion, it might just be a dream. Tell me where the three things are."
Li Lei adjusted his mentality and prepared to take the three things Shitou mentioned.
If Shitou hadn't been persistent in persuading Li Lei to come, Li Lei wouldn't have wanted to bring more people here. After all, Li Lei had to continue on his way and couldn't waste time.
